prompt_edits: §2 preamble (new, before four bullets): 'PARTITIONING GOVERNS DEPTH, NEVER SURFACE COVERAGE.' Mandatory SHARED RELEASE SWEEP every pass executes first (~10min, deterministic): extract text from every release surface (PDF, EPUB, _assembled.md, README, Appendix C), record per-surface (a) build-witness string presence, (b) canonical-number fingerprint. Round 1: exactly 1 of 4 passes opened the EPUB; other three never learned it predates every Nov 3-7 fix (verified: EPUB lacks 'all seven', 'step-budget caveat', 'Two commits, two roles'; contains 0.641 x8, 0.500 x7).

§2 preamble: 'Surfaces not opened' — each pass enumerates release surfaces it did NOT open and why; silence treated as a coverage claim and scored as a miss. Round 1's miss table had to be reconstructed post hoc because no pass declared its denominator.

§2 MiMo bullet: append Makefile target assertion — every scripts/*.py token in a recipe exists; every .PHONY has a recipe; run `make reproduce` and record exit code. R3-EX-04 found by luck; a 20-line linter finds it in one second.

§2 DeepSeek bullet: denominator must appear AT THE POINT OF USE, not reconstructable from an appendix 40 pages later. Any magnitude adjective (small/tiny/negligible/tightly stable/identical) applied to a measured quantity must print the dispersion/CI supporting it; if CI spans zero OR compared arms differ in n_per/steps, the adjective is auto-P1 SCOPE OVERREACH. (Ch.19 still says 'small in-distribution cost' while its own seed table shows 0.820/0.570/0.840 vs 0.950 flat.)

§2 DeepSeek bullet (anchor discipline): cite the PRINTED chapter/section number from the built PDF's TOC, never the manuscript filename. Filenames offset by up to four: ch21_*.md = printed 19, ch22_*.md = printed 20, ch25_*.md = printed 21; no ch19/ch23/ch24 files exist. My own STAT-02 anchors mixed the two namespaces.

§2 Qwen bullet: split clean-clone check into three separately reported outcomes: (a) fresh git clone at DOCUMENTED commit (ignored/untracked unavailable); (b) HEAD; (c) git ls-files census of every path the gate opens. Round 1 merged 'gate crashes at HEAD' (not the documented checkout) with '5/114 mismatches at af32fb8b' into one P1 whose repro command does not test its own claim.

§3 evidence tiers: add EXECUTED-INSTRUMENT for geometry/print — overlap/overflow/label-size claims must ship measured coordinates (bbox, overlap pt) from a committed script; model vision may only corroborate. Round 1 carried R1P-004 and R4G-005 as vision-based despite §3 saying only EXECUTED-DETERMINISTIC may be CONFIRMED.

§1 Phase B: 'A round is INVALID without the adjudication matrix.' One row per P0/P1: {id, challenger (different model), re-derivation command, verdict UPHELD/DOWNGRADED/DISPROVED, author_recused:true}. round1_synthesis.md contains no such matrix — asserts 'All CONFIRMED' with zero adversarial re-derivation, so §1 was declared but not executed. Fix belongs in the synthesizer's acceptance criteria.

§5: 'The ledger is the submission format, not a document about the findings.' Each pass returns JSON validated by scripts/validate_findings.py (seven §3 fields enforced mechanically); unvalidated round = void. Round 1 named issue_ledger.json in §5 and the file does not exist (R3-EX-06) — proof prose-only schema enforcement fails.

§6.8 seeded-defect recall: assign owner + floor. Synthesizer plants 3 defects before each round — one superseded number in a NON-PDF surface (EPUB), one false provenance sentence, one geometry overlap >=20pt — and measures recall. <3/3 caught invalidates that round's 'clean' verdict for the planted classes.

§4 'Report PASSED checks with counts' -> 'report EXAMINED counts per class (figures measured, tables audited, claims inventoried, surfaces opened)'. A pass that cannot state how many items it looked at reports DENOMINATOR UNKNOWN and cannot contribute to READY.
gate_additions: BUILD WITNESS (single check, kills R3-EX-01, R3-EX-05, QWEN-R2-02). PDF and EPUB builds each emit witness `BUILD_COMMIT=<40-hex>` (PDF docinfo + colophon line; EPUB dc:identifier suffix) rendered from git rev-parse HEAD at build time. Gate asserts: witness present exactly once per surface; == manifest.pdf_build_commit; ancestor of HEAD; git diff --name-only <witness> HEAD -- book/manuscript empty. Today verify_release.py:79 hardcodes BUILD_COMMIT and line 469 computes `head` and never uses it — connecting those two lines turns a false colophon into a red gate. Current blind spot: prints 277/277 PASS at HEAD 49831ce4 while shipped PDF contains text introduced in 49831ce4 ('Two commits, two roles'), i.e. not built from the af32fb8b it claims.

SURFACE PARITY SCRIPT (scripts/check_surfaces.py). Extract plain text from PDF (pymupdf), EPUB (zipfile+regex), _assembled.md, README; derive canonical number registry from artifacts/manifests/*.json; assert per surface: canonical-value set equal, every superseded value (0.641, 0.500, 0.900-class n=300, 0.143, 0.350) appears only within +/-200 chars of a SUPERSEDED/supersedes/historical token. Deterministic, <5s, no GPU; would have flagged EPUB (0.641 x8, 0.500 x7, zero labels) and _assembled.md (44 hits of 0.383/0.900, no label, last touched Sep 10) before any model read a page.

TRACKED-INPUTS CENSUS. Parse every path literal opened by verify_release.py and run scripts; git ls-files --error-unmatch each at documented commit; report REQUIRED-BUT-UNTRACKED. Catches QWEN-R2-01/R4-01 (7 tokenizers, 38 checkpoints, 5 datasets gitignored) in one pass, statically, without a clone or a crash.

CLEAN-CLONE SMOKE IN CI. git clone . $TMP/cc && checkout <documented-commit> && python scripts/verify_release.py must exit 0, plus same at HEAD. Working-tree invocation cannot see the failure because gitignored artifacts sit on disk. The one check that proves 'reproduction from the artifact' rather than argues it.

PRODUCING-COMMIT LEDGER (docs/producing_commits.json). For each shipped result manifest: P = git log -1 --format=%H -- <json>; assert git rev-parse P:scripts/<runner> == git hash-object scripts/<runner>; on mismatch emit DRIFT + diff hunks touching random/seed/config lines. Directly catches R3-EX-02 (random.seed added 2026-11-05, manifests committed 2026-11-03) and makes 'producing script == shipped script' a fact instead of a review finding.
MAKEFILE TARGET LINTER. Every scripts/*.py token in a recipe exists; every .PHONY has a recipe; make -n parse-clean. Catches R3-EX-04 in milliseconds.

CLAIM-INVENTORY LINT (docs/claims.json). Regex manuscript for reproduc|regenerab|deterministic|ships|pinned|identical|version-controlled; each hit maps to a claim ID with executable assertion + current status; unmapped hit = P1. Book currently makes 'regenerable from the recorded config and seed' twice (ch09:172, appendix_c:590) and 'the repository ships ... scored dataset files' a third time — all three one grep from being a red gate; three models found them only by reading.
